items.description: PaperShip is an app that allows users to annotate & share documents. The app syncs with a user's Mendeley and Zotero accounts. The app is available on the Mac Store for iPad, iPhone, and Mac Desktop.

The feedly app aggregates a user's favorite sites into a streamlined summary. Feedly uses RSS feeds to display cards pertaining to a user's curated tastes. Feedly for iOS is compatible with iPhone and iPad, with syncing available for use on multiple devices. Feedly's social functions make sharing content to major social hubs very easy. Feedly also syncs with Pocket, Instapaper, and Evernote to allow personal information management across apps.
Pulls social network share counts into your Chrome browser. Utilizes APIs from Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google+, Delicious, Reddit, Pinterest, and StumbleUpon.
An online social game that covertly teaches students how to do library research while they go about the business of completing a research-and-writing assignment.
Comment Stack is a mashup of ReadSocial and Readability. Allowing users to quickly reference content across platforms.
Scovry is a web discovery site that gets data from multiple popular social sources. This data is shown in an easy to follow streaming ticker format.

Subscribe to your favorite RSS Feeds and have them automatically appear in Instapaper. Login to Instascriber with your Instapaper credentials and enter the RSS feeds you would like to appear in Instapaper. Automatically add new items to Instapaper as they are published.
Makes it easy to review and delete/keep your old delicious bookmarks by showing the web page in a n iframe right next to some delete/keep buttons

Subscribe to your Delicious TV feed and program your Boxe TV from delicous. Bookmark videos, genre listings, playlists, other peoples Delicious TV listings, etc. to delicious, then view them in Boxee.
Enter a del.icio.us user name and get a list of website recommendations based on the likings of this del.icio.us user.
Finds related web sites to a given one from within the pool of (previously) popular web sites on delicious.com.
A social bookmarking site for submitting your favorite links. Others can add links or simply vote for the link.
A bookmarking site for submitting your favorite links. Others can add links or simply vote for the link.
Workouts is a flex based application that uses the del.icio.us API to find workouts related to user selected muscle groups.
Aggregate news from all around the web, provide related stories, wikinews, tags, wikipedia links, flickr photos , tweets and more...

One key part missing from del.icio.us is a full-text search API. Delicious Search Exploder uses Yahoo Query Language, Pipes, and a couple of native feeds from Delicious to provide an on-page search-and-browse experience for users, tags, and sites.
Lists the most popular bookmarks in del.icio.us over specific time periods, such as 4 hours, a day, a week, a month and a year.
Uses PHP and xslt to transform RSS feeds from Flickr into thumbnailed HTML pages. See demo and download code to run it on your own site.
A personalized information portal from Mauritius Island which integrates Flickr and del.icio.us.
This experiment is about relating flickr.com or del.icio.us user to each other based on usage of similar tags.
Personal recommendations for users of bookmark services. Enter your del.icio.us username, and get recommendations based on like-minded people.
Web tool for cleaning your del.icio.us tags. It can detect and merge your duplicate tags automatically.
Compress single or multiple URL's, publish straight to your Twitter and Del.icio.us accounts, add passwords to compressed URL's. URL's can be tagged when publishing to del.icio.us.

Ajaxonomy del.icio.us Spy is an application that allows you to find the newest bookmarks added to del.icio.us. The application allows you to filter the links that appear and has links to easily share the bookmark.
Preview what everyone is bookmarking in del.icio.us. With this Google gadget, you can preview, add tabs, and remove tabs for the tags in the Tagcloud.
A Mac OS X desktop application that lets you browse your del.icio.us accounts.
Mac OS X 10 Spotlight plug-in to search del.icio.us
suchR.de is a German mapping mashup about tags and places. If you register and log in, you can add places, points, to create and document your maps.
For those who like to be inspired by random delicious bookmarks.
Simple JavaScript app to find bookmarks from del.icio.us.
A tag-based search engine that combines results from Flickr, delicious, Technorati and Google News.
A collection of stuff to do with Flickr image manipulation, community based photo search engine and a system to print photos on shirts, mugs, and stickers.
Slurlmarker uses your del.icio.us account to create a bookmark slurl of your favorite locations in Second Life.
mashfot is a one-page view about photography. You can find links, news and photos on this site.
A recommendation link list generator extracted from site owner's bookmarks archived in del.icio.us. Entire generation process is via client side JavaScript.

My Del.icio.us Recommendation Snippet is a recommendation link list generator extracted from site owners bookmarks archived in del.icio.us. If you tell your del.icio.us ID to the site, you can get the site owner's bookmarks as a recommendation.

Oishii is kind of a del.icio.us mini-zeitgeist. oishii: ephemeral pheromonal del.icio.us-ness. It polls the del.icio.us front page every 5 minutes, and returns all sites bookmarked by at least 30 people.

trendalicious is a near real-time view of website popularity trends as reflected by the del.icio.us social bookmarking service. All URLs posted by a minimum of two people in past sixty minutes are displayed, ranked by the total number of recent posts.

Combines the del.icio.us online bookmarking service with Google Mobile. This allows you to browse through mobilized versions of your del.icio.us bookmarks from your phone browser or other limited-display browsers
A cool blend of digg.com and del.ico.us See live updates of what is being dugg and what is being linked.
A set of graphic visualisations for your del.icio.us account that allow you to browse, search and select tags, as well as viewing posts matching them.
This nice graphing application shows you the count of del.icio.us tags applied to a given URL over time. By Terrell Russell.
Social bookmarking and folksonomies for Google Maps
Alternative interface to Amazon. Primarily via Amazon AWS, also incorporates del.icio.us, GMail, DropCash, Blogger and a library lookup.

Mashup of Amazon (for album/book details), Audioscrobbler (for related artists), Flickr (for tagged photos), del.icio.us (for tagged links), Blogdigger (for media files) and Feedster (for matching weblog posts).

System Information for Windows is a tool that gathers detailed information about your system properties and settings. Includes detailed specs for hardware, software and networks, as well as realtime monitors for CPU and memory usage.
Swiss Police crime news directly on the maps. Polizei Nachrichten Mashup mit Darstellung auf einer Google Karte.

The website historicplaces.net was created in 2012 as a comprehensive listing of buildings, structures, objects, and sites in North America that have received a special status based on their historical or archaeological significance. We have almost 100.000 historic places listed in our database.
iLoveInns is a Bed and Breakfast locator. Search by location or by a region to drill down. It also has gift certificates, a shopping cart, my favorites and other features.

By combining the Motel 6 property database with a list of attractions and cross-indexing them in Google Maps, the Attraction Finder functions as a searchable trip planner. Also, make a reservation near a desired vacation spot.
See live photo uploads on FLickr.com as they happen.
KGI Wireless are using a combination of MSN Virtual Earth and MapPoint technology to map its wireless towers and associated profiles around the USA.
Sets up alerts when invoices are late and calls someone to ask them where your money is. Plays clips of Stewie Griffin (from the TV series, Family Guy) at various late payment points.
A ghost report community where you can post your true ghost encounter. Find and view other ghost encounters using the Google Maps map. Find similar cases around the world or in your town.

Enter multiple URLs to analyze the interactions / popularity across Facebook, Google+, LinkedIn, Twitter and Pinterest. The calculated social page authority score is based on the number of social interactions found for a specific URL.
Leverages a database of 117,000 cell phone tower locations and Google Maps to help you see where coverage is and isn't.
Find Country on Map is a simple game in which you have to click on a map where you think a country is.

Lets a business share docs from their Microsoft SkyDrive over SMS via Twilio. Go to the app which is running on Windows Azure, set which SkyDrive account to use, and select a public file to share over SMS. Customers (incl. potential customers) can call the Twilio number associated with the #docs deployment and text link to get a link to whatever doc you're currently sharing (for deals, specials, marketing info, etc.) For the sample #docs deployment, call my Twilio number (415)599-2671, enter passcode 7392-3266, and message link.
Search and listen to songs instantly.
Browse your tweets in the opposite way
A tourism and venue website. Brings together thousands of audio, video, and PDF files about places to visit in over 20 countries. Uses RSS feeds and Google Maps.
Find and track live music near you. Track your favorite bands.

Interactive Travel Guide featuring 16,000+ destination guides, a full-screen interactive map, traveler reviews, videos, and 10,000+ photos. Combines Google Maps, WikiTravel, Wikipedia, Placeopedia, YouTube, and Google Video.
psynchr is a Flash based web service to view multiple photosets. You can synchronize multiple photosets on flickr.
SimpleScrobbler is a Last.fm scrobbler without all the bells and whistles. A Mac App that lives in your status bar and leaves a smaller footprint on your computer.

Combyo.com aggregates shopping deals coupons from top deal sites like Fatwallet, Slickdeals, Shopzilla and others. It presents them with real-time price comparison side by side. Combyo.com visitors can also set price alerts.
Search for and get maps and directions to businesses in your area.
A ridiculously easy way to find and print coupons for spas, restaurants, entertainment, services, and more, anywhere in the United States.
Tour the locations of the Da Vinci Code on this Google Map. Includes locations and routes in France, UK, and Italy.
Android application that uses several APIs to bring to the user all information of his/her favorite musics and artists, including discography, biography, lyrics and where to buy links.
A sundial trail around the city of Oxford, UK. Has simplified mobile version.
Tthis is a resources for expats looking for work outside of America.

CubeSensors are devices that contain seven different sensors for detecting air quality, temperature, humidity, noise, light, barometric pressure, and sensor motion in indoor environments. The CubeSensors App allows users to get alerts and recommendations regarding sensor data on their mobile devices. The app is optimized to look good on smartphones, tablets, and web browsers.

Toronto apartment rental search engine which mashes Google maps with apartment reviews, rental listings via Craigslist and property managers, subway stops and grocery stores. Renters can search by Toronto neighbourhood, intersection and subway station.
Calls you when you've lost your phone, and lets you record a public message telling everyone where you found it.
Kijiji is a group of local, community-based classifieds websites.
Watch videos while you post to your friends on Twitter.

No more raffle tickets or business cards in a hat. Attendees enter using their mobile phone and you randomly pick a winner. No download required. Works on iPhone, Android, Blackberry, Windows 7 phones and others.
Nationwide map listing thousands of garage sales pulled from Craigslist and its own users. All sales take place within the next two weeks.
Mapping application for locating real estate listings in the UK.
Stay connected with your friends and contacts in your social networks on the go. Vodafone Update provides mobile access to Twitter, Facebook and MySpace, combined in a single UI.
Use this map to find tennis jobs throughout the US. The site uses the Google Maps mashed with the Indeed.com job database. First 50 matching tennis related jobs are displayed on the map.
OzNewsy is a mobile application that enables users to explore the history and culture of their current location while being in Australia. This mashup uses National Library of Australia Trove API.
Whenever you check in with Foursquare and you're near a transit stop, 4sqtransit will send back a text message with realtime schedule information for that location.
A music mashup of Lastfm, Musicbrainz, Lyricsfly, Youtube and Google Maps.
Service that motivates and rewards people for being active.
ARSights is a Web-based tool for visualizing Google Earth 3D models using augmented reality.
TripAdvisor has mashed up millions of hotel reviews with Google maps for a hotel search that sorts by user-generated popularity index and allows filtering by price and availability.
Map of local entertainment events: concerts, plays, films, talks, magic shows, and comedy.
View galleries of black-and-white images. You can view the images with your own tags, or browse the latest or most popular tags.
Explore related Twitter trends and see livestreams, timelines and the top retweets for that trend.
Send messages to Twitter with voice. This is a speech to text service that allows Twitter users to speak their Tweets from their phone.
MapLib.net is a free service that allows users to upload pictures that may be as large as 6000 by 6000 and create their own custom Google maps.
Uses the Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs to connect people using webcams.
Mashup of Google Maps with the most recent venture capital deals and startups in Silicon Valley.

LyricStatus allows you to share your favorite lyrics with your Facebook friends. Simply highlight your favorite lines from a song and post straight to Facebook as a status. You can post lyrics to your own wall, or you can utilize the Facebook Graph API to post to your friends' wall.
The True Knowledge Firefox add-on enhances your search engine results by inserting a direct answer to your question above your regular search results.

Gastro is a Google Maps mashup of the NSW Food Authority's name-and-shame lists. It collates the Register of Offences and the Register of Penalty Notices and displays the location of offending restaurants on a map. Source code available.
YouTube search engine with results in RSS or JSON.
An extension to CloudShout. Lists all current visitors to your blog that have provided their LastFM username. Clicking on them plays their LastFM library.
User driven search where users contribute listings, reviews, pictures, tags, and more. Toronto is first city setup, includes mapped traffic conditions.

When you listen to music with Audioscrobbler, MusicRambler shows on a map images and events about the artist you are listening to. Enter your Last.FM login and then switch on Audioscrobbler. English version at www.musicrambler.org.
meetmeat helps you make and manage plans with your friends over SMS. Text meetmeat a time, location and group of friends and meetmeat sends out invitations and deals with RSVPs.
Send SMS notifications to subscribers when you publish a new post on your Wordpress-powered website. Currently in Beta testing.
A visually rich interactive Flash tool for exploring place based on the geotagged photos at Flickr. Search by user, tag and collection.

Magellan Strategies is an online company that provides survey research, predictive data modeling and political voter data analysis services to political campaigns, campaign organizations, government and public affairs. Magellan Strategies' goal is to help political campaigns and other organizations to have a better understanding of their audience, in order to improve and strengthen their campaign strategies.
A cross-platform graphical client for Amazon Web Services, AWS. Manage S3 storage and EC2 clouds on the Mac, Windows or Linux. The services are integrated into a GUI, for simple task completion.
Use this interactive Flash-based app to browse EA's Spore creatures to decide how will you browse the Universe.
A service built on top of Twitter messages. You send out a tweet with GPS coordinates and tags for your location to @tweetaloc, and it is searchable there.
Explore the fantasy world of role playing game Oblivion, The Elder Scrolls IV, using this custom Google Map.
Get a Foursquare widget for your site.
Created for Photo Hack Day 2011, Tag Fight! participants send texts to fight over what type of photos to display full-screen.

Tele-Town Hall is a web company that provides elected officials, political candidates, non-profit organizations, associations, and businesses with mass personal communications. Tele-Town Hall helps its clients to reach and connect with their customers/supporters through telecommunication.
A Pentomino Puzzle. It is created by using the OpenLayers Mapping API. Move, rotate and reflect the 12 pieces to find a solution for the rectangles layout.

Google maps mashup combines driving directions and local search. On My Way is a useful facility for getting driving directions for a journey on Google Maps with points of interest on the way route also indicated.
Videos from Iran after election day. Includes videos of Riots in Tehran shown on maps where they occurred.
Search for a rest area anywhere in the US. Information includes services at the rest area.

RallyBound is a social fundraising platform that lets individuals from around the web to create custom campaigns for their causes. Some of the features available on RallyBound include custom campaign designs, direct donation from supporters, multiple campaign management (one site for multiple campaigns), and more.
More Than F1 is a free, web-based, fantasy F1 Management game. Pick drivers, chassis, engine and sponsors then watch your teamâ€™s fortunes and finances develop!
A quick and simple responsive developer portfolio theme for jekyll sites and GitHub Pages.
U.S. Election 2008 application that blends Silverlight 1.0, AJAX, ASP.NET, and Virtual Earth. Provides biographies, images, links, and feeds for presidential candidates.
Task Management for Google Apps. Easily create an actionable task from any email. Assign, schedule, label and star items. Producteev is also available as Android, iPhone, web and Gmail apps.
Users can Dub any YouTube video with the sound of the other video, classify them as funny, sad, action etc. View user videos and then share their creations with friends. More uses onsite.
VitaminsMatch aggregates information on vitamins and helps users find what they need easily. Once a selection is made, the user is directed to the source of the product.
Search for golf videos, tutorials and golf courses, with each mapped.

The internet magazine via-ferrata.de has created a wide selection of some of the most beautiful Klettersteige, vie ferrate, in the Alps. Brand new is the selection of regions and vie ferrate by using Google Maps.
Google Latitude and Google Maps mashup displaying live camera streams from around the world. Click the markers to watch in real time.

What do you get when you cross Craigslist and YouTube? ...CytiTube! Watch from and upload to your city's stream of YouTube videos. If you don't see your city listed in either the World cities or U.S. cities list, just go to the search tab and type it in. Filter your search by category, keywords, author, and search radius. Like Craigslist, when you return to the app after closing you will be brought back to the Most Recent video list from the last city/location for which you searched. Built for mobile browsers but works in all.

moTube is a mobile subscription service that allows people to receive notifications via text message (SMS/MMS) each time a new video is published to a YouTube channel. We created moTube as a way for people to get realtime updates from their favorite YouTube channels directly on their phone. It's a free service and we don't charge subscribers for the notifications sent to their device. Keep in mind that the text messaging plan you have with your mobile carrier still applies. For example, if you have an unlimited messaging plan and receive an update from moTube, you will not be charged anything. moTube is currently in beta, so YouTubers who want to add moTube to their channel must have an invite which we're currently accepting requests for on our website (http://motube.us/).
Create map riddles for your friends and the world.
At MoveTracks.com you to create iTunes playlists called MoveTracks based on your geographic location and any drive you are planning to take.
Get all your special baby products from bol.com.
This Mashup aggregates Vine videos from around the world. Have fun searching for new videos that you have not yet seen.

Yaptap enables communities to communicate however they wish: by text, email, phone, or social media. Group leaders can use either a web or mobile (iPad) application to organize groups, events and communications while members use the tools they want (text or email).

XNSPY can be used as a parental or employee phone monitoring solution to determine a phone user's GPS location as well as additional phone data. The app enables one to monitor SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, Line, Skype, iMessage, and other IM chats automatically. XNSPY can monitor outgoing and incoming calls, record phone calls, receive instant 24/7 alerts, and more.
Italian mashup for cycling routes.
Enabling record labels to offer previews to artist fan clubs months in advance of releases, driving up pre-sales.
Pakistan's complete map with home address search.
Free film recommendation tool. Choose your mood, get movie suggestions, watch trailers, read info, director, cast and user reviews.
A WordPress plugin that protects your blog from spam comments. It learns from your training and after a short while will adapt to your personal blog and will accurately detect incoming spam.
Find Amazon.com prime eligible items. See more results, with price, rankings, and pictures. Also has spelling suggestion and can be added to Firefox search toolbar.
Discussing based site as long as its about any place in the world. For example, plot your local school and tell everyone what you think of it. Plot your local bar and discuss its beer prices.
Vacation rental listings.
Local classified ads for jobs, housing, personals, services, items for sale, and more.
An efficient Captcha Bypass Service.

Moball is a mobile marketing platform that delivers custom native, and location-aware smartphone apps. With Moball, businesses will be able to promote their brands by connecting to existing content on the web such as social media sites, booking systems, and shopping carts.
Zeiss European store finder for Germany.

Raise the Money is an online company that provides an application that allows political candidates and committees to accept donations/contributions on their websites. Raise the Money is a platform that connects political candidates with their supporters from around the web.
WikiMapia is a project to describe the whole planet Earth. Done as a community-built geographic WikiPedia. Just move the map to find interesting places, click on rectangles, create your own.
Zvents allows users to discover events by location and type. For active event locations, Zvents leverages the Active.com API.
Find Meetup groups in your area based on topic keyword and current geographic location.
Shows user's top tracks and it's correlation with this tracks total listening count. User can watch youtube video for any track on chart.
FIFA, World Cup Soccer 2006 map. Latest team news via Yahoo FIFA 2006 World Cup Soccer RSS feeds and Goolge News feeds.

The Udacity Android App allows users to access Udacity's programming courses from their mobile Android devices. Courses are taught by experts from companies like Facebook, Google, and Cloudera and cover programming in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Java, and other languages. The app allows users to solve programming problems and respond to short quizzes on the go.
Online DNS lookup: remote DNS lookup (nslookup/dig) a host or domain from 30+ locations worldwide.

This web application allows you to enter a keyword or hashtag, and the finds the people on Twitter who are the most influential when it comes to tweeting about that subject. Influence is based on retweets. You then have the option to follow that person or retweet what the person followed. You can also send a tweet to the author. This is a great app for determining who the trendsetters are on social media.
Shopping products from multiple stores (new and used), multiple tracking IDs, out-of-stock email alerts, and promotion and customer comments.
Rapid coding and collaboration tool that also integrates directly with the Basecamp task management service.
Virtual Earth 3D Scenes is a simple mashup that automatically cycles through a set of Virtual Earth 3D Scenes every minute. This mashup shows how to control the screen view of Virtual Earth 3D.

Create time-based subtitles for any YouTube video, a la closed captioning. These captions become publicly accessible, and visitors to the site can browse the set of videos with captions. Think of it as a subtitle graffiti wall for YouTube.
View freelance jobs from Indeed.

A PowerPoint mixer to select a PowerPoint presentation on the fly from SlideShare. It uses the SlideShare.net API and pretty effects by script.aculo.us and prototype.js to select a random slideshow for a given tag.

Time travel through Facebook with FB Time Machine. This mashup uses Facebook, Facebook Graph and the Google App Engine and lets you view all of your friends' status updates and posted links (ever). Results are displayed on one page.

Use the Core Web Vitals checker to see if your website passes the Google web vitals test including: # Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) # First Input Delay (FID) # Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) When a page doesn't pass the Core Web Vitals test, the tool will show the issues that need to be addressed to pass the test.

A web and mobile application that gives users insight to their heart, by tracking cardio exercise, daily activities, blood pressure, weight, and sleep patterns. Users of the application will have enough information about their own health to make informed decisions. This application also gives users the ability to design their own workout system in pursuing a better living style.
Aanbieding is the leading discount app in The Netherlands.
To accurately and completely map the progress of Jack Aubrey, Stephen Maturin and their ships over the course of the 21 novels by Patrick OBrian.
Drawloop's service is an online PDF conversion tool integrated with box.net online storage. It allows you to convert a single file into PDF format or merge multiple files into a single PDF.
Find wild creatures for EA Spore using this Google gadget for asset search views.

Joomailer is a complete newsletter solution for the CMS Joomla!. There are 2 versions: one that works with Mailchimp and the other with Campaign Monitor. The Mailchimp Version is also mashed up with the Google Analytics API to provide detailed reports.
Instantly create mashups between two different Youtube videos.

Track all metrics - CPC CTR, Cost of Conversions etc. - of your Google AdWords campaigns. Analyze clicks, impressions, conversions per campaign and drill down to view the metrics for the groups within a campaign. Works for MCC accounts too.

Use Call the Company to directly call human representatives at major companies. Just type in the company and/or department you are searching for, and click to connect right in your browser so you don't have to use expensive cell phone or long-distance minutes.
Image search in the 2 million royalty free images in photo bank Fotolia. Also use it to create instant e-cards.
Ari@ne 6 is a meta search engine.
Eliminate dropped calls and increase data speeds with a signal booster.
Displays book sales on an interactive map.
This is a mash-up of Google Calendar, Google Maps with our church management software that tracks church events and locations of small groups that are meeting.
CallMom provides a channel for buyers and brands to interact, allowing brands to capture customer feedback while they are shopping.
This application helps users visualize satellite dish positioning using Google Maps.
Storefront built on Amazon eCommerce with millions of products from a wide variety of categories and hundreds of merchants with competitive prices.
Rendezvous Spot.com is dedicated to finding a great meeting place that isn't too far for both parties.
Hurricane Watch visualizes Atlantic hurricane tracks and advisories from 1950 to the present, displaying the content in coordinated map and timeline viewers.

The Yahoo! GeoPlanet API contains about six million places, and YPlaces puts them all at your fingertips. The data is organized like a family, with brothers and sisters, kids and parents, and presented in the form of a tree.
Twitalyzer is for tracking influence and measuring success in Twitter. It evaluates your Twitter activity in five categories: influence, signal-to-noise ratio, generosity, velocity and clout.
When on the move, get closest Velib (in Paris), Vélo'v (in Lyon) or Le Vélo' (in Marseille) stations with available bikes or free slots.
Maps the speeches, messages of support and upcoming meetings, from www.flocktogether.org.uk, of Ming Campbell MP, candidate to lead the UK Liberal Democrats.
Plunker Lets you edit, fork and preview web snippets online. The Mashup is made possible by GutHub and Plunker.
This Electronic Arts game uses the YouTube API to let you upload your in-game videos directly to YouTube from Spore.
See what gets uploaded to flickr.com right now.
Automated photo mosaics using Flickr
A very fun Flickr game in which you view a set of ten images and try to guess the common tag. Time based scoring.

Maiana is a social service to host, explore and share Topic Maps sources. Maiana provides mashups to deliver the structured content into blogs and other CMS. For enforcing semantic interoperability subj3ct.com is used.
An interactive map that displays news for the specific country you click on. A Google Maps, Google News, and Geonames.org mashup.

GlueToGo is a tool that let's you see what your friends and other people on Glue are saying when you don't have access to Glue. It runs as a bookmarklet in your browser (any browser will do) and displays information about the object you see.

Moveboxer is the best way to find a reputable mover and instantly get a quote for your move. Moveboxer combines Yelp ratings and reviews with a price estimate so users have more information along the way and can select the movers of their choice to get in touch with them.
Japanese mashup combining videos and Google Maps.
Just three steps allow you to ind where to recycle almost any product. Google Maps API with Ajax make it easy. The site has a search as you type feature and resizeable screen width.
This mashup allows Box.net users to load spreadsheet files directly from their Box accounts into EditGrid, where they can be viewed and edited, then saved back to a Box account.
Search Flickr for geotagged photos and then plot them on a Google Map. Nice nested map-within-a-map.
Yellow pages for Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
Online aromatherapy shop created using Shopping API. Price comparison with direct product links to stores. Aromtherapy.eu has subdomains for US, DE, FR, and AU. Main domain used for UK Shopping API.
200,000 hotels on one map.
See the location of elaborate Christmas lights displays. Readers can add comments and vote for favorites.
Yosle yard sale mapper. Check out all the yard sales in your area. Over 5000 sales every weekend.

TapTravel is a mobile application that allows users to search for and book for flights. TapTravel is available in all major mobile platforms. The Allmyles API has been integrated into this application.
The Pinguinale 2006 is an event in Wuppertal, Germany, because of the 125 birthday of the Wuppertaler Zoo. Map shows the places of 200 pinguins and photos of them. Firefox works better.
Yoga directory that provides live maps in the listings.
Enter your start and end destinations and the mashup will show what tweets lie on the way.
Compare Prices website based on the eBay Commerce API platform. Site is fully responsive and can adapt to any screen size including mobile.
Sign up for free bitcoin price alerts. Bitwat.ch is a free service. You will only receive an email when your price target is met.
Explore Bournemouth UK on a Virtual Earth Map with birds eye views and panoramic photos.

mapTheGraph is a location based social network, currently integrated with Facebook. It lets you update and share interesting places you've been to on a map. It is a social network that replaces the status update with the location update.

Boost is a mobile application that enables users to pre-order their drinks online to pick up at the Boost juice store or have it delivered to them (depending on location). Boost uses MYOB AccountRight Live API, which allows customers to interact with Boost individually.

Displays the current world ocean forecast data using Google Maps to quickly navigate around the world to locate your required coastal region. Data includes wave height, direction, period and wind strength and direction.
Plots points and tracks from GPX files onto Virtual Earth maps.
STEL Order is an invoicing web application that provides businesses a way to securely synchronize their data on the cloud. This application uses Fakturoid API.
Job search site that will plot job locations on a Google Map.
Shopping comparison service with local shopping focus. Search for national products and see availability at stores near you.
Present your local Website on a Google Map with this mashup.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.

SeiDiStrada allows one to search for shops, attractions, and places while on a route. You can insert the starting point, the end point, and a keyword for the place you want to reach. It will extract a list of possible results, by selecting a single one you can go to google maps and refine your trip.
Are you always going to the same bar, club or restaurant and want to find something new that is similar to the one you like? Use wahili to find new but similar nightlife spots!

Grabbing trends from Google, Twitter, Yahoo! & YouTube and aggregating them into a single site. View trend snapshots (taken about every 45 min.), or blended into a daily wordcloud visualization to see relative trend popularity for the day.
A user makes a call from their phone to Platd. They say the number of a car's license plate and then record a message for that driver.

ShoesNBags is the first, native iPhone app for Zappos catalog searching. It is easy to use and allows users to browse, search and buy products from Zappos.com. It works on all iOS devices and it requires Internet connectivity.
